Oyster Therapeutics · brandmark brainstorm, round fourteen

Filled, like the 3D models

Round thirteen’s 01, filled in and given depth, in the language of the 3D story. BRD4 and VHL take the story’s protein colours (pink and lilac in Nacre, gold and mint in Tidepool) with its ink outline, and depth comes the way the 3D models show it: contour rings at even depths, toon shading from a light at the top left, a soft gradient, or rings and shading together. The pearl and its linker are as before. Structures: PDB 5T35, Gadd et al., Nat. Chem. Biol. 2017; the degrader is drawn generically.
